listing.name: An OK Portrait Pack
listing.summary: Adds 300 new character portraits distributed across factions.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 300 new character portraits distributed across factions.

description:
faction sample

freelancer sample

AN OK PORTRAIT PACK -
300 total portraits
30  new portraits per faction (15 male / 15 female)
50  for pirates and player/independent factions
100% of experts agree it's curated quality controlled and vanilla friendly.
Can add mid game, compatible with all mods

!Best used with https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=27381.0 so that you can enjoy it all on demand.

Only download source currently is Nexusmods https://www.nexusmods.com/starsector/mods/115

(If someone is willing to upload a mirror of it to google or mega I'd appreciate it, it's complicated for me living abroad)

*This mod uses [redacted] technology on an industrial but not administrator level. [Stable Diffusion, Photoshop, and human frustration working together in harmony]
